blocks.raw: <Warn>The distinction between Commission review of **rules** (must pre-approve) vs. **disciplinary decisions** (appeal only) is one of the most frequently tested concepts. For rules: Commission pre-approval is required. For disciplinary decisions: Board decides independently; Commission only reviews if appealed. Know this asymmetry cold.</Warn>

blocks.raw: <Tip>The 14 powers of the PRBoA can be grouped into four categories: (1) **Rulemaking** — IRR, ethical code, CPD guidelines; (2) **Licensing** — registration, examination, special permits; (3) **Adjudicatory** — hearing cases, issuing subpoenas, imposing discipline; and (4) **Supervisory** — monitoring practice conditions, ensuring education quality, computerizing exams. Exam questions often test which power falls into which category.</Tip>
